name: Raise on the 17th: two segments in one month
source: synthetic — replace with anonymised real cases
derivation: The salary rises from 24,000,000 to 30,000,000 on 17 August 2026, so the month has two segments: 1-16 (12 working days) and 17-31 (10 working days), 22 in all, every one paid.
Each segment is pro-rated on its own and rounded on its own, the way an accountant checks it by hand:

ALW_PHONE 500,000 is a fixed component, so attendance does not touch it; it follows the segment's share of the 31 employed days: 500,000 x 16/31 = 258,064.51 -> 258,065 and 500,000 x 15/31 = 241,935.48 -> 241,935, together exactly 500,000. It is exempt, so it adds nothing taxable.
The insurance base follows the terms in force at the end of the period (rule last_segment): 30,000,000.
